author: golem
body:
# Source-only plan for remaining consumer qualification

The existing human control/return result and release40 are recorded; no publication or extra visual acceptance is inferred. Root's audio pair41 is complete/released and its offline comparison reproduces; Oryx is currently free, not granted to a new target.

GOLEM-057 ROW-003 now requests a concise SOURCE-ONLY plan under your existing owner task for the remaining original33-case consumer matrix/interpreter qualification. Identify what genuinely remains beyond the passing host/generic both-engine checks and actual six-view application20capture Pi/Oryx proof. Preserve original case/oracle scope and exact module/firmware/backend identities. The now-proven application transport may support a separately frozen continuation, but changed transport/pacing cannot relabel the original upload partial or prove its cause fixed. Do not substitute the six-view subset for the original full matrix.

Recommend the smallest useful tranche that moves those actual remaining gates forward, with workload coverage, old/new fixture boundaries, estimated interpreter cost and finite first-failure/cleanup bounds. Avoid repeating passed checks just for reassurance. Separate correctness from copied/direct performance and physical claims. If a particular original matrix item is redundant or not actually required, explain the scope/evidence explicitly for root review rather than silently dropping it.

This authorizes the plan writeup only, not helper/source changes, build, profile reset/staging, emulator run or lease. Keep current reviewed application/source/profile and saved human evidence unchanged; source planning may proceed while acceptance/publication questions remain pending. No broad new task or feature migration is assigned. Return proposal or concrete scope issue through mailbox plus immediate chat.
